Lean 4.33.1 lessons added to the class file: linarith/nlinarith auto-collect the whole local context - on heavy real-constant contexts (nIdeal/Noff/wallLo/p8_B terms) they blow isDefEq/whnf heartbeats; restrict with 'linarith only [...]' and then RE-ADD every dropped local fact the proof actually needs (set-alias hS2def, intro-hypotheses, weak-inequality companions); simp does NOT discharge an if-test conjunction from a stored conjunction hypothesis (it rewrites conjunct-by-conjunct, leaving the residue if) - use if_pos <proof-of-conjunction> / if_neg <negation> with exact test propositions; rpow bridge for (x)^(2:REAL) = x^2 needs the 3-step rw [rpow_neg ... 2]; rw [show (2:REAL) = (2:NAT) from by norm_num]; rw [rpow_natCast x 2] (the bare show-bridge alone leaves the natcast-2 rpow unexpanded); le_div_iff does not exist in this mathlib - le_div_iff0 (a <= b/c <-> a*c <= b, 0 < c) is the right name; S4WinCap's Xgrow positivity theorem is S4WC.hXgrowPos (namespace S4WC, not the module name); Real.log_pos takes its x implicitly - Real.log_pos (h : 1 < x), never Real.log_pos x h; a nested calc inside a calc-step by-block is a parse error (unexpected token calc) - restructure with have + rw [show ... from by ring] + exact; mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left wants 0 <= c, not 0 < c (wrap with le_of_lt); field_simp leaves the polynomial residue of (16 d0^2)^(2) after clearing inverses - follow with ring.
